ideas.title: Tripwire axes — negative-control decoys inside every embedding call
ideas.excerpt: I-1. Tripwire axes — negative-control decoys inside every embedding call. Extend the sealed 8-axis noul battery with four DECOY axes in the same batched call: two semantically far ("does the record substantively concern 17th-century naval architecture?", "…recipe substitution in baking?") and two near-miss confusables ("…a fictional or narrative-creative piece?", "…a human scientist's biography?"). ideas.title: Axis algebra with pre-registered compositions — analogy arithmetic you can read
ideas.excerpt: I-2. Axis algebra with pre-registered compositions — analogy arithmetic you can read. Pure recomposition of the *sealed* E-Q22 noul vectors — near-zero new calls. Before any query, seal 10 compositions as predictions (the sealed-prediction law): each is v(a) − v(b) + v(c) with a named target record, chosen so the intended meaning is legible off the axis deltas. Examples: v(N1) − v(P5) + v(Q2) → keep nonlocal ≈ 0.9, strip local-rule mass, add quantum provenance → predicted target Q1 (the certified root feeding construction); v(A4) + v(N2) − v(A1) → "the economics of a dead non-local deployment"

ideas.title: Psychometrics of the embedder — IRT discrimination ladders per axis
ideas.excerpt: I-6. Psychometrics of the embedder — IRT discrimination ladders per axis. The moonshot: treat the question map as a test instrument and the records as examinees. For each of the 8 axis concepts write a 5-rung strictness ladder — "does the record mention {concept} at all" → "…touch on it in passing" → "…discuss it substantively" → "…is largely about it" → "…is centrally about it" — all noul; embed the 20-record corpus with the 40-question battery (one batched call per record; 40 questions is well under the measured 96-question high-water).
